## Problem and behavior

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify anything unrun or blocked.
For documentation, include relative-link and stale-reference checks.

## Review notes

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, contracts, and migration notes are updated.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic; no private drawings, personal paths, or credentials are included.
- [ ] Required third-party notices are preserved.
